topic.title: Community: A community garden grows food and friendship
topic.focus: A community garden grows food and friendship

candidate_instructions: Read all five sections. Answer Questions 1-5. Follow the stated word limits exactly.

sections.heading: An empty lot in the city
sections.text: In 2014, there is an empty lot in a poor neighborhood. The lot is dirty and full of trash. Nobody uses it. The neighbors do not know each other. It is not a happy place.

sections.heading: A dream of green
sections.text: A man named Luis has a dream. He wants to make a garden. He talks to his neighbors. They like the idea. Together, they clean the lot. They remove the trash. They bring soil and seeds.

sections.heading: Planting together
sections.text: In spring, the neighbors plant vegetables. They plant tomatoes, beans, and squash. Every day, someone waters the plants. Children help. Old people help. Young people help. Everyone works together.

sections.heading: Harvest and celebration
sections.text: By summer, the garden is full of fresh food. Families harvest vegetables. They share the food with their neighbors. They have a big party in the garden. They eat together. They laugh together. The garden brings the community together.

sections.heading: A real community now
sections.text: Today, the garden feeds 40 families. But it does more than that. Neighbors know each other now. They help each other. If someone is sick, neighbors bring food. If someone needs help, everyone comes. A simple garden made a community strong and kind.

passage.full_text:
Paragraph 1 — An empty lot in the city
In 2014, there is an empty lot in a poor neighborhood. The lot is dirty and full of trash. Nobody uses it. The neighbors do not know each other. It is not a happy place.

Paragraph 2 — A dream of green
A man named Luis has a dream. He wants to make a garden. He talks to his neighbors. They like the idea. Together, they clean the lot. They remove the trash. They bring soil and seeds.

Paragraph 3 — Planting together
In spring, the neighbors plant vegetables. They plant tomatoes, beans, and squash. Every day, someone waters the plants. Children help. Old people help. Young people help. Everyone works together.

Paragraph 4 — Harvest and celebration
By summer, the garden is full of fresh food. Families harvest vegetables. They share the food with their neighbors. They have a big party in the garden. They eat together. They laugh together. The garden brings the community together.

Paragraph 5 — A real community now
Today, the garden feeds 40 families. But it does more than that. Neighbors know each other now. They help each other. If someone is sick, neighbors bring food. If someone needs help, everyone comes. A simple garden made a community strong and kind.
